hooks.command: uv run --no-project "scripts/safety_guard.py" --host antigravity || { rc=$?; printf 'BLOCKED: core-hooks safety hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 2; }
uv run --no-project "scripts/pre_git_hook.py" --host antigravity || { rc=$?; printf 'BLOCKED: core-hooks git policy hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 2; }
uv run --no-project "scripts/zsh_traps.py" --host antigravity || { rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 3 ]; then exit 2; fi; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks zsh trap hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }
uv run --no-project "scripts/post_tool_use.py" --host antigravity || { rc=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks logging hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }

Stop.command: uv run --no-project "scripts/system_notification.py" --success --host antigravity || { rc=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks notification hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }
